summary: Version 2 of the TikZ figure compiles, passes topology check (all edges verified), and received a critic score of 0.92 with no must_repair flag. It draws the circle centred at O (radius 76 px), solid baseline A--C--E, solid A--B, dashed B--O and O--D radii, solid C--D and D--E, and a right-angle mark at C. Labels A, B, C, D, E, O are placed. The spurious U and F labels are not drawn.
